note: Unwrapped `openclaw <subcommand>` string literals and CLI argv arrays in src/, extensions/, and packages/ fail the build guard unless they are formatCliCommand/replaceCliName/formatInlineCliCommand arguments or listed here. Exemptions are for template helpers that return the raw name for a formatCliCommand caller, or genuine non-user-facing protocol/type strings. User-facing help, doctor, recovery, pairing, and hook-relay copy must go through the rewrite path.
